description.en: The micro FPV camera class with a 19 × 19 mm body, held in a frame bay or a printed cage by two side screws about which it tilts.
description.es: La clase de cámara FPV micro con cuerpo de 19 × 19 mm, sujeta en el hueco del marco o en una jaula impresa por dos tornillos laterales alrededor de los cuales se inclina.
description.fr: La classe de caméra FPV micro à corps de 19 × 19 mm, tenue dans la baie du châssis ou une cage imprimée par deux vis latérales autour desquelles elle s'incline.
description.pt: A classe de câmara FPV micro com corpo de 19 × 19 mm, presa no compartimento do quadro ou numa gaiola impressa por dois parafusos laterais em torno dos quais inclina.

governing.designation: Micro FPV camera, 19 × 19 mm body (COTS class)

frame_convention: Origin on the side-screw axis (the axis through the two side mounting screws, about which the camera tilts), midway between the two side faces. +x along the optical axis, out through the lens; +z up; +y to the camera's left. The side faces sit at y = ±9.5.

interfaces.note: Male: the body goes into the bay or cage. Symmetry 0: a mate's angle_deg sets the tilt about the side-screw axis.

review_status.note: Drafted in one pass by an agent (P4-STD lane, 2026-10-02); facts read from the cited sources on the access date; no language facet has had a native review.

notes: The side-screw thread and its height on the body are not published by the cited listings, so they are not facts here; the frame convention is defined by the screw axis instead of a number.
